taskCall.context:
# Goal
Tameshi round 12 only; axes depth + calibration. L1 integration owner. C1 calibration capability: repeated pristine-control gate: N>=3 runs, identical exit/stdout/stderr required; any nonzero baseline is could-not-evaluate, any output/exit disagreement fails; no flakiness cured or determinism proven. C2 depth: declared-witness split for pinned bash-surface-census (10 defects); existing 6 recorded gate legs unchanged; never count reanalysis as a seventh independent gate. Source registry and mistake frontier within these two claims.
# Contract
Repo /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tameshi-shokunin. Read PROVINCE.md and corpus/QUALITY.md. Leaves only, no delegation; no fleet/sibling writes or commits. Only assigned files may be written. Do not build/lint/test/format mid-flight; experiments explicitly assigned are evidence probes, not suite verification. L1 runs integrated checks afterward. Any reports are advisory lane-internal, NOT independent non-author promotion/admission. Tooling authorization: you and every seat may install or upgrade tools that help the task — read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first (official channels, update-safety gate, record tool/version/channel/reason in the report). No secret content reads. Every change covered by L1 LOG.md round entry.
New gate interface: python3 tools/repeat-control.py --runs 3 --out DIR -- COMMAND ARG... . Run exact argv with stdin DEVNULL; save numbered stdout/stderr and exit; do not normalize bytes. Gate final stable finding IDs: controls_match exit0 clean; controls_mismatch exit1 failed; baseline_nonzero and command_unavailable exit2 could-not-evaluate; invalid usage exit64 could-not-evaluate. --selftest uses isolated fixtures and exact IDs/exits; --snapshot DIR validates committed input digests and expected ID/exit, tamper exit2 snapshot_tampered. No edits to existing mutation runner.
Evidence destinations .ufo/evidence/round-12/{seat}/; own one seat directory only unless specifically assigned production file. No circular waits. Review assigned contract or existing evidence immediately; report concrete counterexamples/commands. L1 may send later integrated check request in same identity. Append own final report at wave report path if renderer requests, do not overwrite another report.
